system.description:
ARCHIVIST

One school of sacred scholarship was never going to contain your curiosity.
Select a second Archival Discipline. You gain that discipline's Specialist Skill, 1st-level Specialist Spell and Discipline Ability.
You do not gain its 7th-level Advanced Specialist Spell. Your original discipline remains your primary discipline whenever an ability specifically refers to your Archival Discipline.

Prerequisites Level 9

Use to choose your second Archival Discipline: it arrives as an ability with its specialist skill and 1st-level specialist spell (delete its 7th-level spell if the level grants it).
